descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S03 Nursing Home, UAT steps 2–3 in the app (three tasks typed by hand): two close, third open, conditional task, no retraction task; closed ones shown as finished

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 A retraction ('leave glargine at 20') does not become a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T2 Tasks closed by dictation show as completed, with the visit they were closed on (TFA-92585 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician; the fixture resident starts In Today (snf:add defaults inTodaysSession to true), so the Nursing Home Task Export lists them; three tasks added by hand with Add Task (stand-in for step 1, Q3)

When Type the UAT bedside dictation into the visit notes and tap Save & Extract; open Post-Round → Tasks, then Task Export

Then Post-Round: '2 pending tasks' (weight + the diet task), all three original texts still listed once, no glargine/insulin task. Task Export: weight pending above Finished Tasks; follow up BMP and PT eval under Finished Tasks, each with the resident's current visit on its own row

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-22 Expected Result (step 4) + TFA-92585 AC 8. The diet task is worded by the model, so it needs a regex (diet/clears + pain + 4, either order, Q6); the order in Task Export needs mustAppearInOrder; the visit check is bound to each finished row and to the visit in the chart header ({currentVisit}, read from s03-n-after-extract.md), Fail (known) until PR #106 (doneVisit). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
